description.narrative: Tiiiit! Inc. is an all-female-led organization located in the capital of the Republic of North Macedonia. With the belief that transformation could be achieved by reclaiming public space and public discourse such as institutions of culture, public schools, social and traditional media, literature, and conducting various forms of informal education - all in favour of overcoming the stigmatization of female sexuality, and generally femininity and other gender identifications that vary from the strongly appointed gender norms, identifications considered taboo, shame and secret. The grant will support the following specific priorities and activities: - Staff and office costs; - Menstrual poverty advocacy; - Team retreat and strategic planning; - Performing arts platform: Rehearsing feminist future; - Firstborn Girl Festival
